title: SSL/TLS Certificates Refund Terms Schedule
content:
Refund terms schedule — SSL/TLS Certificates. A subscription purchase or renewal charge of any Harborline certificate product may be refunded in full within the refund window shown below, counted in calendar days after the charge; the schedule also records whether a refund revokes the certificate of an issued subscription and whether any part of a charge is refunded once the window has passed.

| Certificate product | Refund window: calendar days after a purchase or renewal charge within which it may be refunded in full | A refund of an issued subscription revokes its certificate | Any part of a charge refunded after the refund window |
|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline DV Single Domain | 30 | Yes | No |
| Harborline DV Multi-Domain | 30 | Yes | No |
| Harborline DV Wildcard | 30 | Yes | No |
| Harborline OV Single Domain | 30 | Yes | No |
| Harborline OV Wildcard | 30 | Yes | No |
| Harborline EV Single Domain | 30 | Yes | No |
| Harborline EV Multi-Domain | 30 | Yes | No |

## Condition and result

| Condition | Result under every product |
|---|---|
| A purchase or renewal charge, within 30 calendar days after it | May be refunded in full |
| A charge after its refund window | No part of it is refunded |
| A refund of an issued subscription | Its certificate is revoked |

**Does the schedule differ between DV, OV and EV products?** No. The window of 30 calendar days, the revocation on refund of an issued subscription and the absence of any refund after the window are the same for all seven products.
